sun.management

类 ConnectorAddressLink

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.management.ConnectorAddressLink

  • public class ConnectorAddressLink
extends Object
    A utility class to support the exporting and importing of the address of a connector server using the instrumentation buffer.
    从以下版本开始:
    1.5

    • 构造器概要

      构造器

    • 方法概要

      所有方法 静态方法 具体方法 
      限定符和类型 方法和说明
      static void export(String address)
      Exports the specified connector address to the instrumentation buffer so that it can be read by this or other Java virtual machines running on the same system.
      static void exportRemote(Map<String,String> properties)
      Exports the specified remote connector address and associated configuration properties to the instrumentation buffer so that it can be read by this or other Java virtual machines running on the same system.
      static String importFrom(int vmid)
      Imports the connector address from the instrument buffer of the specified Java virtual machine.
      static Map<String,String> importRemoteFrom(int vmid)
      Imports the remote connector address and associated configuration properties from the instrument buffer of the specified Java virtual machine.

    • 方法详细资料

      • export

        public static void export(String address)
        Exports the specified connector address to the instrumentation buffer so that it can be read by this or other Java virtual machines running on the same system.
        参数:
        address - The connector address.

      • importFrom

        public static String importFrom(int vmid)
                         throws IOException
        Imports the connector address from the instrument buffer of the specified Java virtual machine.
        参数:
        vmid - an identifier that uniquely identifies a local Java virtual machine, or 0 to indicate the current Java virtual machine.
        返回:
        the value of the connector address, or null if the target VM has not exported a connector address.
        抛出:
        IOException - An I/O error occurred while trying to acquire the instrumentation buffer.

      • exportRemote

        public static void exportRemote(Map<String,String> properties)
        Exports the specified remote connector address and associated configuration properties to the instrumentation buffer so that it can be read by this or other Java virtual machines running on the same system.
        参数:
        properties - The remote connector address properties.

      • importRemoteFrom

        public static Map<String,String> importRemoteFrom(int vmid)
                                           throws IOException
        Imports the remote connector address and associated configuration properties from the instrument buffer of the specified Java virtual machine.
        参数:
        vmid - an identifier that uniquely identifies a local Java virtual machine, or 0 to indicate the current Java virtual machine.
        返回:
        a map containing the remote connector's properties, or an empty map if the target VM has not exported the remote connector's properties.
        抛出:
        IOException - An I/O error occurred while trying to acquire the instrumentation buffer.
